overall_goal: Prepare frothed hot milk for a cappuccino.

goals.description: Open the milk carton and pour milk into a cup.
goals.rationale: The person opens the milk carton, removes the inner packaging, and pours milk into the cup.

goals.description: Heat the cup of milk in the microwave.
goals.rationale: The person places the cup of milk into the microwave to heat it and subsequently retrieves it.

goals.description: Froth the heated milk using a milk frother.
goals.rationale: The person picks up the milk frother, positions the cup, and turns on the frother to make froth in the milk.
